description: Use this when the user asks whether DNS for a domain is healthy or misconfigured. Returns nameserver match, A/AAAA/MX, SPF/DMARC hints, score and grade. Read-only public check via Lanetti Tools. Not for editing DNS.

domain.description: Public FQDN, e.g. example.com or example.fi. Localhost, private and metadata addresses are rejected.

name: oma_check_dns_health
title: Check DNS health
